title: Value produced by a gate
statement: Let $f$ assign a value to each gate and current value list, and let $g_0,\ldots,g_{m-1}$ be a finite gate list with initial value list $v$. For any index $i<m$ and default value $d$, the value at index $|v|+i$ after successively evaluating the gates is $f(g_i, w)$, where $w$ is the list obtained by evaluating just the first $i$ gates starting from $v$.
hypotheses_covered: An index $i$ less than the gate-list length
